summary: Kayrouz has a clear founding story since 2006, a named team and a WhatsApp link. Typos, duplicate content and a lack of proof weaken a firm that wants corporate clients.

findings.problem: Visible typos: Ladnline instead of Landline, and Ethical pactice in the Responsible Business menu. The brand shows as Kayrouz & Associates and Kayrouz & Partners.
findings.cost: A law firm that sells precision cannot have typos in its own menu and contact details.
findings.fix: A proofread build with one brand name.

findings.problem: No testimonials, case results, awards or client logos appear. The only proof is 4,500+ matters handled, with no source or date.
findings.cost: Corporate clients look for proof and a claim without a source is easy to doubt.
findings.fix: Named client quotes, case outcomes and a sourced figure.

findings.problem: The Branded Residence in Dubai card appears three times, Founded in 2006 repeats, and the footer shows Language Language and an unexplained tagline Know & Advise.
findings.cost: Repeated content and stray labels push your real services down and look unfinished.
findings.fix: One clean version of each section.

findings.problem: All three calls to action go to the same long form, with phone required but email optional. WhatsApp appears only as a small footer icon, and date formats vary.
findings.cost: A long form and a hidden WhatsApp lose clients who want a quick first message.
findings.fix: A short intake form and a visible WhatsApp button.

redesign: A consultation first page with a short form, visible WhatsApp and a calendar link.
Named proof beside every button and one clean set of practice pages.
